scripts.seed: pnpm --filter teacher-service seed && pnpm --filter auth-service seed
scripts.seed:all: pnpm --filter auth-service migrate && pnpm --filter auth-service seed && pnpm --filter teacher-service seed && pnpm --filter student-service seed
scripts.db:reset: cd database && docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.start: concurrently "pnpm --filter api-gateway start" "pnpm --filter teacher-service start" "pnpm --filter student-service start" "pnpm --filter notification-service start"
scripts.start:services: concurrently "pnpm --filter teacher-service start" "pnpm --filter student-service start" "pnpm --filter notification-service start"
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter api-gateway dev" "pnpm --filter teacher-service dev" "pnpm --filter student-service dev" "pnpm --filter notification-service dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-Student run dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-main run dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-Teacher run dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-Exam run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "pnpm --filter api-gateway dev" "pnpm --filter teacher-service dev" "pnpm --filter student-service dev" "pnpm --filter notification-service dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently "npm --prefix Evolve-Student run dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-main run dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-Teacher run dev" "npm --prefix Evolve-Exam run dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter auth-service test && pnpm --filter teacher-service test && pnpm --filter student-service test
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter auth-service clean && pnpm --filter teacher-service clean && pnpm --filter student-service clean && pnpm --filter api-gateway clean
